answer_1.quote: As one of the major natural language generation tasks, automatic summarization has been studied for decades.

answer_2.quote: ROUGE ) is a commonly used automatic metric for summarization tasks. ... BERTScore  goes beyond n-gram overlap to provide contextualized semantic similarity.

answer_4.quote: we conduct a human evaluation on Amazon Mechanical Turk. ... we ask human annotators to rate the 'salience' and 'faithfulness' of model-generated summaries.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rated salience and faithfulness on a 5-point Likert scale and performed pairwise comparisons for salience, faithfulness, and overall quality.
